property.name: Text 1

property.value: I have a feeling that chip was developed somewhere away from prying eyes. A place where you would have the equipment and with strong viruses to keep it hard to reach

property.name: Text 1
property.value: I think you should get rid of it, but if you really want to try to salvage it then maybe an old friend of mine could... NAH. Get rid of it, trust me!

property.name: Text 1
property.value: That's a weird chip you have there, where'd you get it? This is not a normal battle chip... I've fought against all types of battle chips including Dark Chips, this is something else entirely. Let me see that.

property.name: Text 1
property.value: Huh? You don't seem to have it on you.

property.name: Text 1
property.value: I knew it, this isn't a regular NaviChip. A regular chip can withstand physical attacks, but this one got damaged. I suggest you get rid of it, it won't even work. Here you go.

property.name: Text 1
property.value: What happened to your battle chip? Haha GutsMan did this? Typical, he attacks first and asks questions later. I can help you get it fixed.

property.name: Text 1
property.value: Uh... you don't have the chip on you.

property.name: Text 1
property.value: Hmm... this chip is giving off weird energy. I have a feeling we shouldn't be messing with it. Here, it is yours after all

property.name: Text 1
property.value: I don't think I've ever seen this type of chip. I have a feeling it was developed in a place that was never meant to be found.
